decision.reason: [ev-c695c8267edf] is only a commit title from the changelog: "chore!: add 60s default jitter (#22342)". It doesn't name what the jitter applies to (which setting, flag, env var or component). It also gives no before or after values and doesn't say what changes for an operator who does nothing. The '!' marks the change as breaking, but the text doesn't explain how. We need the upgrade guide entry or the PR #22342 description to identify the subject, the default change and the consequence.
